title: [SEC6] Good: Contact blocking respected in renderContactList
description:
In app.js renderContactList() (lines 157-173), the code explicitly skips blocked contacts:

  if (contact.blocked) continue;

A malicious or noisy contact can be blocked at the server level, and the client respects that. The UI won't render a chat button for blocked contacts.

This is a simple but important correctness choice. Not checking the flag would allow users to accidentally re-engage with blocked contacts. The check is in the right place (during list rendering, before any click handler is attached).
